governance_matrix.decision_scope: Strategic oversight of fellowship progress; review of milestone achievement against the work plan; approval of changes to the Career Development Plan; resolution of issues beyond day-to-day research coordination; primary point of escalation to the HOST institution for matters requiring institutional support.
governance_matrix.escalation_path: Unresolved matters are escalated to the HOST institutional management (ELTE Faculty of Informatics, Institute of Cartography and Geoinformatics). Any grant-related escalation is handled via HOST consistent with the grant agreement implementation provisions applicable to the beneficiary (Tier 1 source: governance_principles.json grant_agreement_implementation_articles, traceable to wp-15-general-annexes_horizon-2026-2027_en.pdf pp.35-36). This escalation path is framed as a project governance route consistent with Tier 1 implementation provisions and does not assert a generic Horizon practice.

risk_register.description: High-resolution PlanetScope imagery, valuable for small horticultural plots, may not be secured due to cost/access constraints, weakening coverage where the sub-pixel problem bites hardest.
risk_register.mitigation: Treat PlanetScope as an optional enhancement; build the core on open Copernicus Sentinel-1 + Sentinel-2 data; resolve access early (RQ8). [Affects: WP1 (Probabilistic multi-sensor diagnosis of the field state)]

risk_register.description: Reconciling the differing spatial and temporal resolutions of radar, optical, soil and weather sources may fail or degrade the fusion quality.
risk_register.mitigation: Geospatial/time-series data platform with QC; temporal compositing; explicit resolution handling. [Affects: WP1 (Probabilistic multi-sensor diagnosis of the field state)]

risk_register.description: Cloud cover limits Sentinel-2 optical availability, while dense vegetation reduces Sentinel-1 SAR retrieval accuracy - the two sensors' complementary weaknesses.
risk_register.mitigation: Lean on Sentinel-1 SAR through cloud; cloud masking; vegetation-aware retrieval. [Affects: WP1 (Probabilistic multi-sensor diagnosis of the field state)]

risk_register.description: Few large-scale efforts collect dense ground truth, so the validation may be under-powered to establish credibility.
risk_register.mitigation: Plan field trials with dense ground truth (RQ4); use a cost-effective sensor network. [Affects: WP3 (Field validation, ground truth and uncertainty calibration)]

risk_register.description: Route B's central assumption - that the chosen homogeneous patch genuinely covaries with the target crop - may not hold, invalidating the proxy.
risk_register.mitigation: Pre-register a covariation test; measure covariation (control stand) rather than assume it (RQ9). [Affects: WP3 (Field validation, ground truth and uncertainty calibration)]

risk_register.description: The framework's headline commitment - honest uncertainty - fails if e.g. 90% prediction intervals do not contain the truth about 90% of the time.
risk_register.mitigation: Build uncertainty-calibration metrics into the validation protocol (RQ5); use uncertainty-aware calibration end to end. [Affects: WP2 (Uncertainty-aware decision engine and demonstrator integration), WP3 (Field validation, ground truth and uncertainty calibration)]

risk_register.description: The rigorous one-step probabilistic fusion route may exceed available modelling expertise, validation data or compute within the fellowship.
risk_register.mitigation: Keep Route B as a credible fallback; stage the build; provision the probabilistic-modelling compute runtime. [Affects: WP1 (Probabilistic multi-sensor diagnosis of the field state)]

risk_register.description: Calibrating AquaCrop to a single overconfident parameter set would break the uncertainty chain and produce falsely confident decisions.
risk_register.mitigation: Uncertainty-aware AquaCrop calibration that retains parameter uncertainty (the fellow-attributed method, doi:10.1016/j.envsoft.2022.105556). [Affects: WP2 (Uncertainty-aware decision engine and demonstrator integration)]

risk_register.description: Integrating and calibrating heterogeneous sensors (radar, optical, soil, weather) adds complexity that can degrade signal quality.
risk_register.mitigation: QC pipeline; sensor comparison in the validation layer. [Affects: WP1 (Probabilistic multi-sensor diagnosis of the field state), WP3 (Field validation, ground truth and uncertainty calibration)]

risk_register.description: Operational frameworks unifying all sensors at scale are scarce, so the demonstrator may not reach a usable pilot within the fellowship.
risk_register.mitigation: Frame the MVP as a standalone research demonstrator; partners assist (feedback, farmer access, testing) rather than own or operate it; set the TRL target explicitly (RQ10). [Affects: WP2 (Uncertainty-aware decision engine and demonstrator integration), WP5 (Dissemination, exploitation, communication and management)]

ethics_assessment.self_assessment_statement: This MSCA-PF action (HORIZON-MSCA-2026-PF-01) requires completion of a mandatory ethics self-assessment as part of the application, per the Tier 1 rule extracted from wp-15-general-annexes_horizon-2026-2027_en.pdf p.16 and programme-guide_horizon_en.pdf pp.25-28 (docs/tier1_normative_framework/extracted/implementation_constraints.json, rule: ethics_self_assessment_required). The self-assessment must address the following dimensions: (1) Artificial Intelligence (ETH-01): The uncertainty-aware decision engine and research demonstrator developed in WP2 constitute an AI-based system; Section A.4 Category 8 of the application ethics table must be completed disclosing this and assessing ethical concerns related to human rights and values and how they are addressed. (2) Environmental and field activities (ETH-02): WP3 field validation at Hungarian tomato farms must be assessed under Section A.4 Category 7 (environment, health and safety) to confirm no adverse environmental, health, or safety implications arise from the measurement protocols. (3) Civil focus: The project has an exclusive civil application focus per Tier 1 rule (implementation_constraints.json civil_focus_constraint, source: wp-15-general-annexes_horizon-2026-2027_en.pdf pp.14-17). No activities involve human embryos, human participants as research subjects, vertebrate animals, or restricted dual-use materials. This must be declared in the application ethics table. (4) Gender equality plan: Host institution HOST (ELTE) is a higher education establishment in an EU Member State and is required to have a gender equality plan at grant signature and during the grant per Tier 1 rule (implementation_constraints.json gender_equality_plan_eligibility, source: wp-15-general-annexes_horizon-2026-2027_en.pdf pp.18-19; programme-guide_horizon_en.pdf pp.16-17). Beneficiaries must promote gender balance at all levels including managerial level per Tier 1 rule (implementation_constraints.json gender_management_balance_guidance, source: wp-15-general-annexes_horizon-2026-2027_en.pdf p.18). (5) Gender dimension in research and innovation content: Integration of the gender dimension in research and innovation content follows the Tier 1 default rule that it is mandatory unless the topic explicitly states non-relevance (implementation_constraints.json gender_dimension_in_content, source: programme-guide_horizon_en.pdf pp.17-20; wp-15-general-annexes_horizon-2026-2027_en.pdf p.24; ef_he-ria-ia_en.pdf pp.4-5). No Tier 2B exemption source is currently cited in this Phase 6 artifact; Phase 8 drafting must either add the relevant Tier 2B topic-source reference or keep the claim framed as pending call-specific confirmation. (6) Open science obligations confirmed in Tier 2B: Training activities must integrate key transferable skills including digital skills and foster Open Science, knowledge valorisation, and research integrity (Tier 2B: call_constraints.json CC-11; scope_requirements.json SR-03). Fellows must be empowered for open access to publications and research outputs including FAIR data management (Tier 2B: call_constraints.json CC-12). The Career Development Plan must include planning for publications and participation in open science events (Tier 2B: call_constraints.json CC-13; scope_requirements.json SR-04). These Tier 2B sources directly confirm the open science requirements recorded as derivative flags in compliance_profile.json open_science_requirements.
